title: Octopus Musician in Surreal Dream
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a central blue octopus-like figure with a flower crown playing an orange guitar, its tentacles swirling with musical notes. The scene includes a melting red heart-shaped border dripping like lava, a stone tower with stairs, a hooded grim reaper figure, melting clocks, floating jellyfish, candles, and various musicians and winged eyes against a swirling colorful sky.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of a blue octopus with a flower crown playing an orange guitar, its tentacles merging with swirling musical notes and green smoke. A large melting red heart frames the top with dripping lava edges, containing a stone tower, jellyfish, grim reaper figures, melting clocks, candles with reflections, and floating musicians under a swirling orange and blue sky filled with eyes and birds.
